y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在这里，我们汇总了关于 ZCode 的产品定位、费用说明以及在使用过程中可能遇到的技术问题的解答。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="product-positioning">1. ZCode 的产品定位是什么？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 是一个全新的智能体开发环境（Agentic Development Environment，ADE），与传统 IDE 不同，ZCode 不以手动编写代码为核心，而是让 AI Agent 成为开发的主角——您只需用自然语言描述需求，Agent 即可驱动从编码、调试到预览的完整开发流程。</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">ADE 平台</strong>：围绕自研 ZCode Agent 内置文件管理、终端、Git 提交及实时浏览器预览，通过自然语言指令驱动 Agent 完成全生命周期开发任务。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">全上下文感知</strong>：Agent 能够深入理解项目结构、文件内容以及 UI 视觉元素，无需记忆复杂的命令行参数。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">当前重点</strong>：围绕自研 ZCode Agent 强化长任务执行和稳定性，把工作区、工具、模型、权限和 Review 串成连续的开发流程。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="is-it-free">2. ZCode 免费吗？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">ZCode 工具本身完全免费</strong>。但作为开发者，您需要准备自己的 API Key 或模型服务套餐。目前支持以下接入方式：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">智谱系列</strong>：GLM Coding Plan 编程套餐、智谱开放平台模型资源包/充值余额、智谱 Z.ai。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">模型服务</strong>：ZCode Agent 可使用已接入的模型服务和套餐。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">企业模型通道</strong>：团队统一维护、供 ZCode Agent 稳定调用的模型通道。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自托管服务</strong>：团队批准的私有化模型服务或专有网络模型资源。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="re-config">3. 我的终端已配置好 GLM API，还需要在 ZCode 重新配置吗？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">需要</strong>。终端环境变量和 ZCode 桌面端的模型配置是两套独立入口，配置不会自动同步。您可以选择以下任一方式：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">快速连接</strong>：在欢迎页面或个人头像处连接 BigModel/Z.ai 账号，若账户内有可用套餐将自动连接。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">手动管理</strong>：通过模型选择器底部的「管理模型」进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">模型设置</strong>，手动添加 Base URL 和 API Key。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="loading-issue">4. Connect 之后一直 Loading？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果模型服务连接一直处于 Loading，请优先检查：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">网络环境</strong>：确保当前网络可以访问对应模型服务。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">账号权限</strong>：确保登录账号或 API Key 拥有可用额度和模型访问权限。</li>
</ol>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="mention-folder">5. 怎么把整个文件夹作为上下文交给 Agent？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有两种方式，都可以。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">@</code> 直接选</strong>：输入框中的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">@</code> 选择器会同时列出文件和文件夹，也可以选择技能和智能体。输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">@</code> 后继续输入名称筛选，用方向键在候选项之间循环选择即可。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">拖拽进输入框</strong>：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">从 ZCode 左侧文件树中拖拽文件夹到输入框。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">从 Finder、资源管理器等系统文件管理器中拖拽文件夹到输入框。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">无论哪种方式，ZCode 都会把该文件夹作为上下文引用，Agent 可以围绕目录结构和其中的文件继续分析或执行任务。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="glm-endpoints-faq">6. GLM Coding Plan、Anthropic 端点、OpenAI 通用端点有什么区别？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">BigModel（国内）与 Z.ai（海外）在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">API Key</strong> 模式下提供 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">三类端点</strong>（详见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/configuration#glm-endpoints">连接模型 → BigModel / Z.ai API 端点说明</a>）：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">端点</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">典型地址（BigModel）</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">何时使用</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Coding Plan 专用</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground">已购 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">GLM Coding Plan</strong>，用 API Key 接入 Coding 场景</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">OpenAI 通用</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground">开放平台<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">模型资源包 / 充值余额</strong>，走 OpenAI 兼容协议</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Anthropic</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground">仅限从未购买过 Coding Plan 且已额外加白的账号；普通资源包 / 余额场景请使用 OpenAI 通用端点</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">常见误区：</strong></p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">买了 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Coding Plan</strong>，却把 OpenAI 地址填成通用端点 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/api/paas/v4</code> → 无法正常消耗编程套餐额度。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">只有<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">资源包 / 余额</strong>，却填了 Coding 端点 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/api/coding/paas/v4</code> → Coding 端点仅限 Coding 场景，不适用于通用 API。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">通过 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">「编程套餐」账号授权</strong>（非 API Key）连接时，无需手动填端点，ZCode 会自动路由。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">海外 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Z.ai</strong> 请将地址中的域名替换为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">api.z.ai</code>，路径规则相同。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="linux-wsl-faq">7. Linux / WSL 下无法启动、登录后没有回到 ZCode、中文输入法用不了？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Linux 桌面和 Windows WSLg 环境下，这三类问题最常见，多数可以按下面的思路快速定位：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">AppImage 无法启动</strong>：多数是缺少 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">libfuse2</code>（Ubuntu / Debian 执行 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">sudo apt install libfuse2</code>）；点击图标无反应时先从终端启动一次看报错；GPU 相关报错可加 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">--disable-gpu</code> 等软件渲染参数。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">浏览器登录完成但没有回到 ZCode</strong>：通常是系统没有正确关联 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">zcode://</code> 打开方式，常见诱因包括用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">sudo</code> 启动、AppImage 登录前后被移动，或 deb 与 AppImage 混装。用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">xdg-mime query default x-scheme-handler/zcode</code> 检查，并将 AppImage 放在固定路径后重新启动。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只能输入英文 / 输入法失效</strong>：和当前会话的 IBus / Fcitx5 环境变量有关，从已配置好输入法环境的 shell 启动 ZCode 即可；WSLg 下首个中文字符不显示是已知兼容性问题，可先输入一个占位字符再删除。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">每一步的完整命令、启动脚本示例，以及反馈问题时需要收集的诊断信息，见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/linux-wsl">Linux / WSL 排查指南</a>。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="context-window">8. 上下文容量显示得比模型实际窗口小？自定义模型的窗口怎么填？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">每个模型条目都带一个 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">上下文窗口</strong> 值，ZCode 按这个值计算容量，规则如下：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新加的模型、或没带窗口信息的模型，默认按 20 万（200000）计算。</strong> 这就是接入百万上下文模型后，容量仍显示 20 万的原因。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">模型 ID 以 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">[1m]</code> 结尾会被识别为百万上下文</strong>，自动按 100 万处理，不需要手填。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">其他情况以你填写的数值为准——需要 1M 就填 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">1000000</code>。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 模型供应商</strong> 里展开对应模型即可修改。注意：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">通过编程套餐（Plan）连接的内置 GLM 模型，窗口由产品统一固定、不可编辑</strong>；只有用 API Key 方式添加的模型才允许自己改。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">会话显示的容量取自该会话<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">当前所选模型</strong>的窗口，所以同一个项目里不同会话显示不同容量是正常的——旧会话沿用它当时用的模型。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="auto-compact">9. 为什么远没用满就开始「自动压缩」？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">自动压缩不是等窗口用满才触发，而是提前留出输出空间和安全缓冲：</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">触发点 = 上下文窗口 − 输出预留（至多 21000）− 约 13000 的安全缓冲</strong></p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">输出预留取「最大输出 Token」与 21000 中的较小值，所以通常合计固定扣掉约 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">3.4 万 token</strong>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">换算下来：128K 窗口约在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">9.4 万</strong> token 触发（约 73%），200K 约在 16.6 万，1M 约在 96.6 万。窗口越小，触发点占比越低，属正常现象。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">触发判定的计数包含本轮工具结果的实时估算，会略高于输入框上方显示的水位——所以有时看起来&quot;没到线&quot;就压缩了。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果窗口本身还在按默认的 20 万计算（见上一条），提前压缩会更明显——先把窗口值填对，再看压缩时机。自动压缩目前没有可配置的开关或阈值。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="subagent-model">10. 子智能体没有用我指定的模型？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">分两种情况：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">内置的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">general-purpose</code> 和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Explore</code></strong>：可以在设置里分别为它们指定模型；<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不指定时继承父会话的主模型</strong>——这是设计行为。想让它们固定用某个模型，就在设置里配上持久覆盖，清空即恢复继承。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自定义 / 工作区 / 插件子智能体</strong>：仍以各自 Markdown 文件里的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">model</code> 字段为准。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">所以「派出去的子智能体跟着主会话的模型跑」在没有配置覆盖时是预期结果，不是故障。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="skills-empty">11. 技能列表是空的，全局技能不显示？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">先确认技能文件放对了位置：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户级（全局）</strong>：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/skills/&lt;技能名&gt;/SKILL.md</code></li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区级</strong>：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&lt;工作区&gt;/.zcode/skills/&lt;技能名&gt;/SKILL.md</code></li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目录为空时，列表里自然不会有全局技能。确认目录里确实有技能后，再按这三步排查：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 技能</strong> 里按来源查看，确认没有被搜索框或来源筛选挡住。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">新建或导入的技能需要点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">刷新</strong> 才会出现。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">检查每项右侧的启用开关是否处于开启状态。</li>
</ol>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">完整的目录结构与导入方式见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/skill">Skill</a>。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="migrate-config">12. 换电脑，要复制哪些配置文件？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">把这几处复制到新机器的相同位置，即可带走绝大部分配置：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">路径</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">带走什么</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/cli/config.json</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">MCP 服务、权限默认值、插件与技能开关、Hooks 等 Agent 配置</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/v2/config.json</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">模型供应商配置（含 API Key、Base URL、模型列表）</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/AGENTS.md</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">全局规则</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/agents/</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/skills/</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/commands/</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">自定义子智能体、技能、命令</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">项目级配置（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&lt;项目&gt;/.zcode/</code> 目录）跟着仓库走，不用单独复制。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不要复制</strong>这两个文件：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/v2/credentials.json</code>（登录凭据按设备加密，换机后无法解密，直接在新机器重新登录即可）和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/v2/telemetry-state.json</code>（含设备标识，不应在两台机器间共用）。会话历史、日志等运行数据也不建议搬运。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="exec-dir">13. <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/cli/exec</code> 目录占了很多空间，能删吗？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">能删。</strong> 这个目录存放的是历史会话中终端命令的输出记录，目前不会自动清理，长期使用会越积越大。在 ZCode 完全退出、且没有后台命令在跑的情况下，可以整个删除——ZCode 会在需要时自动重建。删除的代价只是历史任务里的命令输出无法再回看，不影响任何配置和会话记录。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="app-version">14. 在哪里查看 ZCode 的版本号？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">macOS 在菜单栏 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">ZCode → 关于 ZCode</strong>；Windows / Linux 在标题栏 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">帮助 → 关于 ZCode</strong>。弹窗里会显示当前版本，检查更新时的提示也会带版本号。设置页里目前没有版本信息入口。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="config-mode-renamed">15. 手工维护的 config.json 里 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mode</code> 字段不生效了？<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">子智能体相关配置的键名已从 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mode</code> 更名为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">subagent</code>，属于破坏性变更：旧键不再被读取，也不会自动迁移。如果你直接编辑过 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/</code> 下的 config.json 或用脚本生成配置，请把 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mode</code> 键改为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">subagent</code>。通过设置界面修改的配置不受影响。</p></article><aside aria-label="On this page" class="sticky top-0 z-10 self-start w-70 hidden xl:flex flex-col gap-4 py-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground bg-background"><button type="button" class="text-muted-foreground/50 text-sm font-medium text-left transition-colors hover:text-foreground/80">On this page</button><ul class="sidebar-group space-y-0"><li><a href="#product-positioning" class="group flex items-center pr-3 text-left break-words border-l py-0.5 w-full transition-colors text-sm pl-7 border-white/10 hover:border-foreground/30 text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground">1. ZCode 的产品定位是什么？</a></li><li><a href="#is-it-free" class="group flex items-center pr-3 text-left break-words border-l py-0.5 w-full transition-colors text-sm pl-7 border-white/10 hover:border-foreground/30 text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground">2. ZCode 免费吗？</a></li><li><a href="#re-config" class="group flex items-center pr-3 text-left break-words border-l py-0.5 w-full transition-colors text-sm pl-7 border-white/10 hover:border-foreground/30 text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground">3. 我的终端已配置好 GLM API，还需要在 ZCode 重新配置吗？</a></li><li><a href="#loading-issue" class="group flex items-center pr-3 text-left break-words border-l py-0.5 w-full transition-colors text-sm pl-7 border-white/10 hover:border-foreground/30 text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground">4. Connect 之后一直 Loading？</a></li><li><a href="#mention-folder" class="group flex items-center pr-3 text-left break-words border-l py-0.5 w-full transition-colors text-sm pl-7 border-white/10 hover:border-foreground/30 text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground">5. 怎么把整个文件夹作为上下文交给 Agent？</a></li><li><a href="#glm-endpoints-faq" class="group flex items-center pr-3 text-left break-words border-l py-0.5 w-full transition-colors text-sm pl-7 border-white/10 hover:border-foreground/30 text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground">6.
